subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class Google Chat all-message Space ingestion now, and should the approved path be user OAuth, Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, or a deferred service-account-only stance?
rationale: The remaining request is not a mechanical adapter fix: it changes Google Chat credential scopes, event ingestion, ambient room visibility, setup docs, and security expectations for the bundled plugin.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned auth/events design
options.body: Keep this issue or a narrower successor as the design owner for SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events ingestion, with docs and live Space proof required before implementation lands.

options.title: Split remaining work to canonical issues
options.body: Track user OAuth under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9764 and keep this issue only for the Space all-message product decision after thread fixes land.

options.title: Defer all-message ingestion
options.body: Keep Google Chat service-account HTTP webhook behavior as the supported bundled path and document that non-mention Space ingestion is out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned auth/events design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue or a narrower successor as the design owner for SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events ingestion, with docs and live Space proof required before implementation lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent review/committer history on the same Google Chat auth and threading surfaces and is the clearest owner for the product/security call from the available evidence.
